items.name: XCR-L
items.imageAlt: Transparent wireframe viewport render of the VEYR XCR-L modular rifle
items.overview: The XCR-L is the flagship VEYRFRAME platform: a grounded modular rifle built around reusable attachment interfaces, calibrated aiming states, and a weapon-agnostic framework rather than a single sealed implementation.

specifications.label: Aiming
specifications.value: Standard ADS, canted ADS, tactical stance

specifications.label: Attachment routing
specifications.value: Optic, muzzle, grip, stock, laser, light

features: Shared attachment registry and platform routing
Magazine variants driven through a shared item architecture
Prepared interfaces for PIP optics and magnifiers
attachmentSupport: Suppressors, flash hiders, brakes, and hybrid devices
Grips, stocks, adapters, and magazine variants
knownIssues: Public package remains withheld until final validation passes
Some advanced optic and magnifier combinations still require individual alignment
Release documentation and installer package are not yet staged

items.name: M4
items.imageAlt: Centered wireframe viewport render of the VEYR M4 modular carbine
items.overview: The M4 is the current secondary rifle platform being folded into VEYRFRAME. Its public record remains intentionally narrow while animation work, attachment routing, and final weapon behavior are brought under the shared framework.
features: Prepared stock, grip, light, and laser interfaces
Designed to reuse VEYRFRAME systems instead of duplicating them
attachmentSupport: Compatibility entries marked planned until validated in game
knownIssues: Animation implementation remains the primary workload
Compatibility entries are provisional until final platform validation
No public build or release date is staged

items.imageAlt: Transparent x-ray wireframe render of the VEYR 1911 Classic variant
items.overview: The 1911 is VEYR's dedicated sidearm project. The Classic configuration now fronts the public platform record, with Compact and Kimber variants tracked alongside it as part of the same grounded modular sidearm branch.
